status: frozen_before_campaign; validate instrumentation before main runs
cold: Fresh container/Python/SDK/model process with already-provisioned dependencies and models; OS/filesystem caches not evicted. Report container startup separately and first operation inclusive SDK imports/model load.
warm: Three subsequent jobs in the same SDK process, different output IDs/files for exports and positives, same source for clean negative scans. No concurrency.

corpus.source: Own deterministic Pillow/FFmpeg engineering fixtures; no population realism, durability or production workload claim. Full commands, seeds, metadata and SHA256 retained. Existing client pilot remains a separate narrow data set.

primary_verification_scope: current, matching recommended new-issuer integration; explicitly not an across-legacy negative
additional_control: 720p10s: default all vs current verification on intact positive, metadata-loss positive and clean negative, with pinned legacy engine provisioned

measurement.canonical_cpu: host cgroup v2 cpu.stat usage/user/system deltas across each complete operation, including all processes and exited children
measurement.canonical_memory: same-FD resettable cgroup memory.peak if instrumentation calibration succeeds; total charged memory including resident state/page cache, plus sampled memory.current anon/file and summed RSS (shared mappings may double-count)
measurement.diagnostics: process PID/starttime/role CPU and RSS samples; root self CPU and reaped-child CPU are diagnostic, not substitutes for cgroup total
measurement.host: Host CPU/steal/load/memory and observer CPU recorded; unrelated services retained
measurement.negative: Keep not_found separate from not_checked/timeouts/conflicts; no ID or schedule hints to detector
measurement.boundary: Host request-to-response wall includes minimal IPC/serialization; worker SDK-call wall separately; cold-inclusive container wall/CPU separately

fixtures: Development identity; no real production TSA/network latency, CA enrollment or public trust qualification
log_policy: Append raw measurements/events immediately; checkpoint after each operation; preserve failed attempts. Private keys/registry/media excluded from public handoff.
invariants: No concurrency with other qualification jobs: shared flock
